title: Better Understanding, Better Fixes? A Study of Hallucination in LLM-based Automated Program Repair
abstract: arXiv:2609.04909v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly advanced automated program repair (APR), yet existing evaluations remain largely result-centric and provide limited insight into hallucination during repair. In APR, hallucination may arise not only in final patches but also in the intermediate artifacts that guide patch generation. To address this gap, we perform a multi-layered analysis of hallucination throughout the APR process. Specifically, we characterize hallucination as the production of patches or intermediate artifacts that are not faithfully grounded in the available repair evidence. We examine repair hallucination in final patches and understanding hallucination in intermediate artifacts through three tasks, namely triggering testcase identification, line coverage prediction, and additional testcase generation.We then evaluate three representative LLMs on 832 Defects4J bugs through automatic evaluation and manual analysis. Ou

translated_title: 更好的理解，更好的修复？基于大语言模型的自动程序修复中的幻觉研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）极大地推动了自动程序修复（APR）的发展，然而现有的评估大多以结果为中心，对修复过程中出现的幻觉缺乏深入洞察。在自动程序修复中，幻觉不仅可能出现在最终补丁中，还可能出现在引导补丁生成的中间产物里。为填补这一研究空白，我们对整个APR过程中的幻觉进行了多层次分析。具体而言，我们将幻觉定义为生成的补丁或中间产物未能忠实建立在可用的修复证据之上。我们通过三项任务（即触发测试用例识别、行覆盖率预测和补充测试用例生成）来考察最终补丁中的“修复幻觉”以及中间产物中的“理解幻觉”。随后，我们通过自动评估和人工分析，对三个代表性的大语言模型在832个Defects4J缺陷上进行了评估。
tldr: 该研究首次对基于大语言模型的自动程序修复全过程中的幻觉现象进行多层次分析，区分了最终补丁中的“修复幻觉”与中间产物中的“理解幻觉”，并通过三项任务对三个代表性LLM在832个Defects4J缺陷上进行了系统评估。
en_tdlr: This study presents the first multi-layered analysis of hallucination throughout the LLM-based automated program repair process, distinguishing repair hallucination in final patches from understanding hallucination in intermediate artifacts, and systematically evaluates three representative LLMs across three tasks on 832 Defects4J bugs.
